notes.title: Some new gameplay mechanics, QoL and more
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

I've just updated the Prologue, that used to be the original version of the game, with some features and improvements from the Next Fest demo and the full version.
You'll find lots of [b]QoL updates, bug fixing, better balancing and much more[/b].
Here the full changelog:

[list]
[*]Weapons now have a [b]reload system[/b]
[*][b]Secret rooms[/b]
[*][b]More balanced enemies spawns[/b] in the second level
[*][b]Shotgun overhaul[/b]: 30% more damage, ~11% less damage decay (distance), 20% less spread
[*]Now the previously dead volunteer body will be found [b]closer to the start of the level[/b] (the distance scales with difficulty, closer on easy)
[*][b]Better recoverable equipment[/b] from the previously dead volunteer body (scales with difficulty)
[*]Option to change the [b]zoom type[/b] from original (automatic) to manual
[*]Option to increase the [b]UI size[/b] (menus, documents screens, invetory, etc)
[*][b]Options to reduce UI effects[/b]
[*][b]Option to reduce in-game effects[/b] (scanlines, pixelation)
[*][b]The Worm[/b] behaviour now scales with difficulty (and, while still hard, is [b]more fair to fight[/b])
[*]Armed Soulless now drops a small amount of ammo
[*]Removed the "floating" effect from the documents screen, for better readability
[*]Small bug fixes here and there
[/list]

notes.title: EMPTY SHELL release
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

This is it: the full version of [b]EMPTY SHELL will be released on October 16, 10am PST, right after the Next Fest ends[/b].
The Demo will no longer be available, but i'll update the Prologue around Halloween with the latest version you were able to try during the Next Fest.

The full experience brings a whole lot more:
[list]
[*] You'll travel throughout the entire Facility, visiting [b]all the new locations[/b] to complete the list of tasks given to you
[*] [b]Lots of new monstrosities[/b] will hunt you down
[*] New [b]disturbing bosses[/b]
[*] [b]Plenty of new weapons[/b], from old war equipment to futuristic prototypes
[*] Upgrade your volunteers with [b]new stats[/b] to give them a better chance of surviving
[*] [b]Several new automated Gadgets and Devices[/b] will help you get through this nightmare
[*] [b]Dozens of new achievements[/b]
[*] [b]Secret rooms[/b] to discover and [b]secret items[/b] to collect
[*] Dozens of documents to [b]finally uncover the mistery of what happened during the 1950s[/b]
[/list]

[b]If you played the new Demo or the Prologue, your saves will be carried over the full game[/b], so you can pick up from where you left (or start fresh, you choose).

The price of the full game will be [b]11.99$[/b], but [b]there will be a time-limited release discount[/b], so come and get your copy: [b][i]the operation needs a new volunteer and the Facility is waiting for you[/i][/b].

notes.title: Update: starting bonus/malus
notes.content:
Actually, i spoke too soon: i made a few test and the feature is not engaging enough, so i'm putting this aside, for now!
I'll think about something better :)

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.content:
Hey! Just a quick fix:

[list]
[*] added WASD to navigate the Antennas view
[*] fixed the pan in some areas where the sfx sounded weird
[/list]

notes.title: A quick update on the full version
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

The full version of the game is shaping up nicely and there's already lots of new content.

I wanted to share with you a new simple yet interesting mechanic. It's nothing revolutionary, but it adds a little more to exploration, and many players asked for it in the past weeks, so i've worked on it yesterday.

[b]Here's an example of a secret room[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340112/e9a30a71425e0107123a7450ac0b4f4e341c5bfa.gif[/img]

notes.title: Worm and crash fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The [b]Worm[/b] behaves differently than before (basically [b]no more stunlock[/b] and [b]stronger[/b])
[*]Changed some settings in the enemies path finding; [b]should avoid a problem that sometimes was causing a crash[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: New achievement and (small) difficulty increase
notes.content:
[list]
[*]New [b]LONE SURVIVOR[/b] achievement
[*][b]Hard[/b] and [b]NIGHTMARE[/b] difficulties are now slightly [b]harder[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Loot with (0) amount fixed
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing sometimes spawns of Gadgets and Ammo with (0) amount.
[*]Some other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Devices fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The Shield now protects volunteers from [b]bullets and lasers too[/b]
[*]Shield duration is now [b]4 seconds[/b] (before it was 5)
[*]There are still [b]some threats[/b] that the Shield can't protect the volunteers from (no spoiler)
[*]Devices now have a [b]higher cooldown duration[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: New achievements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added [b]4 new achievements[/b]
[*]Fixed a couple of minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Devices logics fixes
notes.content: Fixed some logics about the use of [b]Devices[/b].

notes.title: Little fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem happening when aiming/shooting and interacting at the same time with a lootable element
[*] Better behaviour of dying bodies while being knocked back against a wall
[*] Auto turret damage slightly reduced
[/list]

notes.title: Better melee and new melee weapons
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Now voluteers can spawn with [b]3 new melee weapons[/b]: a shovel, a crowbar and a hammer.
[*]All the melee weapons now have a proper [b]range of action[/b] and [b]stopping power[/b] (for example, the hammer has the shorter range and almost no stopping power, the shovel has the larger range and decent stopping power).
[*]The final boss has now higher health and mass (that means lower knockback).
[/list]

notes.title: Another small update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem that was preventing to stack gadgets from Upgrade Stations if the inventory was full
[*] Fixed a couple of colliders
[/list]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem that was preventing to reassign aim and shoot keys (mouse only)
[*] Fixed the height conversion of the volunteers (cm/ft)
[/list]

notes.title: New achievements and dynamic codes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]There are now [b]3 new achievements[/b] based on killings
[*][b]The door code in level 1 is now dynamic[/b] and changes every time (used to be 8212)
[/list]

notes.title: Ammo limit and better ragdoll
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Now [b]ammo is capped[/b] (depending on type, you can see the max amount in the inventory). If you're looting, you'll get ammo up to the limit, and if there's more, you'll left the difference behind ([b]still lootable later[/b]).
[*]Ragdoll bodies now have way less mass, so they can still be a dangerous obstacle in crowdy situations, but are [b]easier to push[/b].
[*]Fixed another problem that was preventing to continue from level 2.
[/list]

notes.title: A couple of issues
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with the story screen that was causing the game to freeze before level 2 (using German language)
[*] Added a scrollbar to the options screen (i'm planning to add new options, so i needed more space :))
[/list]

notes.title: New accessibility option
notes.content: Added an option to disable most of the effects on the menu/in-game overviews UI (default is [b]enabled[/b]).

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] From now on, in the Upgrade Stations, some items will be always present, others will spawn based on "rarity" (only protections and a weapon, for now)
[*] Better hand grenades (more damage, more range)
[*] Slightly increased the global difficulty
[*] Score points increased for a couple of enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Inventory freeze fix
notes.content: Fixed a problem that on a few occasions was causing the inventory to freeze.

notes.title: "continue" broken level fixed
notes.content:
Fixed the problem that, sometimes, was causing the second level to freeze at start.
(I could have missed something else, but this one is fixed)

notes.title: Controls binding fix
notes.content:
Fixed a problem that was preventing the correct binding for keyboard controls (seeing twice "move forward" and/or "move right").

Edit: if you still see the problem, just use the new "RESET" button at the bottom of the list, then you're good to go with the binding.

notes.title: Another small update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]solved a problem in the inventory caused by dropping-picking up-dropping again a weapon (could be related to inventory freezes that occasionally occured)
[*]now dropped boxes closed to each other merge together for visual clarity
[*]dropped boxes are now visible in the map (little square icon)
[*]empty dropped boxes are deleted after looting
[/list]

notes.title: Some new improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a sound that alerts you when an enemy is getting too close (useful in messy situations when visibility isn't enough)
[*] Improved damage for the Machine gun auto turret gadget (and slightly increase the amount of ammo)
[*] Improved damage for the Machine gun turret in the "garden"
[*] Now you can see wall tunnels from the map (once you got close enough, they appear in the map with a different color/pattern)
[*] Now you can see Upgrade Stations from the map (once you got close enough, an icon will appear in the map)
[/list]

notes.title: Score system fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue about the score system and leaderboard update (wasn't updating until the first death of the player).

notes.title: Some fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The score wasn't resetting starting a new game (it was starting from the record saved in the leaderboard). [b]Starting a new game now means starting from 0 points[/b], so, to beat your record, you actually have to score more points than before (but you always mantain your previous score in the leaderboard, if you don't reach a higher one).
[*][b]Enemies now gives more points[/b] (at least twice compared to previous version). This is useful to rebalance the leaderboard, cause some scores were too high due to the mentioned problem.
[*]Fixed a bug that broke the game if "continue" was pressed after completing the Prologue.
[/list]

notes.title: New achievements
notes.content:
Added [b]4 new achievements[/b], based on the difficulty you finish the Prologue on.
Higher difficulties unlock lower difficulties achievements (so if you finish the game on Nightmare, you unlock easy, medium and hard achievements as well and so on).
Also added the possibility to [b]switch between your position and top position[/b] in the leaderboard.
